title: Water Cycle teaching-signal inspection
method: Frozen actual runtime in an owned ephemeral localhost server and isolated Chromium. Native controls, actual SVG geometry and computed styles, scenario evidence and paused parcel preservation. No learner tabs, port 8770, runtime edits, or Git writes.
measurementNote: SVG geometry is measured after two painted frames. Heading clearance compares actual horizontal and vertical intersections with individual heading children. results-initial.json preserves the original diagnostic, including pre-paint bounding-box artifacts and the earlier whole-heading clearance assumption. Forced-color screenshots distinguish system-painted HTML text from pale SVG text; explicit CanvasText styles are assessed in the final runtime.
